turnover_by_city.sql:
WITH STORES AS (
  SELECT "storeId", "storeCity", "storeSize"
  FROM store
),
TURNOVER AS (
  SELECT
    STORES."storeCity",
    ROUND(SUM(turnover."amount")::numeric, 2) AS total_turnover,
    ROUND(SUM(turnover."eaches")::numeric, 2) AS total_eaches,
    ROUND(SUM(turnover."marginValue")::numeric, 2) AS margin_value,
    ROUND((SUM(turnover."marginValue") / NULLIF(SUM(turnover."amount"), 0))::numeric, 2) AS total_margin_percent,
    ROUND(SUM(turnover."customer")::numeric, 2) AS total_customer
  FROM turnover
  LEFT JOIN STORES
    ON turnover."storeId" = STORES."storeId"
  GROUP BY STORES."storeCity"
)
SELECT *
FROM TURNOVER;
